title: #312 Morning Work
prompt: Some people prefer to get up early in the morning and start the day’s work. Others prefer to get up later in the day and work until late at night. Which do you prefer? Explain it with your own experience.

promptSegments.text: Some people prefer to get up early in the morning and start the day’s work.
Others prefer to get up later in the day and work until late at night.
Explain it with your own experience.

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Starting the day early allows people time to complete personal activities like walking a dog and eating a good breakfast, leading to a calm and prepared feeling.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Working late at night can be beneficial because the quiet environment helps people focus better and complete tasks without distractions.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Getting up early provides a calm and focused time, allowing individuals to study or complete difficult tasks when their mind is fresh and productive.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Working late at night benefits certain people, such as freelance writers, by offering a quiet environment for deep concentration and meeting deadlines.

angles.en: The essay explains that an early start helps build a positive routine, and a later start can improve work efficiency.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Starting work early is beneficial because it allows individuals to use their peak mental acuity when they are rested, enabling them to tackle complex projects before distractions build up.

promptTraps.en: Do not answer only the first question while neglecting the second requirement; address both dimensions equally.

promptTraps.en: Do not write off-topic generalizations; ground every point in the specific context of Lifestyle.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết chung chung ngoài đề; hãy gắn chặt từng luận điểm vào bối cảnh cụ thể của Lifestyle.
